entries: Reject passing Verdicts when caller-required proof steps are missing, failed, or unavailable. Match structured per-step evidence through the shared implement and ship checker while retaining isolation, identity, notes, open-question, refusal, and cleanup guards. Preserve failed attempts separately from corrective follow-ups and update Verify-skill authoring guidance (#467).
Keep the required-proof rules in the Verdict record reference, with implement, the Verifier, and Verify-skill setup and maintenance pointing to it.
